Name: Stardew VallEasy - Easy Everywhere Anytime
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia]
                                                                   [img]https://i.postimg.cc/T3dJc4K5/Title.png[/img]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]Get a simpler and easier experience for the game, requiring less effort and time. Whatever your goal is, I can assure you that you will achieve it very quickly using this mod. [/i][/b][/size][/color]


[color=#ff7700][b][b][size=4][color=#00ff00]Compatible with all languages. [/color][color=#ffff00](Languages available: English, Spanish and Portuguese).[/color][/size][/b][/b][/color][size=5][color=#ff7700][b]
Recommended mod: "[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b]".[/b][/color]

[b][color=#ff0000]If you are looking for a HARDER game experience I recommend my other mod:
[/color][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6029]Hardew Valley[/url]
[/size]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


                                                                               [img]https://i.postimg.cc/LsNctcVH/Changes.png[/img]

[b][i][size=5][color=#00ffff]All options have various values that you can easily change from the Generic Mod Config Menu and create your perfect game. Many possible combinations. [/color][color=#ff7700]You can also disable all the options you are not interested in. [/color][/size][/i][/b]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

﻿
                                                                               [img]https://i.postimg.cc/bNjTZJ8T/Income.png[/img]


[/font][center][font=Georgia][size=4][b]﻿Several options to increase profits.
Crops, animal products, fish, collectibles and more increase in value up to X10.

[/b][/size][/font][/center][font=Georgia]
                                                                               [img]https://i.postimg.cc/Pxp4wvP6/Crafting.png[/img]


[/font][center][font=Georgia][size=4][b]﻿All the objects you can build need fewer materials to be completed.
No material was removed from the original construction recipes.
[/b][/size][/font][/center][font=Georgia]
                                                                               [img]https://i.postimg.cc/NjDpqw3x/Building.png[/img]


[/font][center][font=Georgia][size=4][b]﻿Reduced the amount of materials and gold needed to start building construction.
No material was removed from the original construction recipes.
[/b][/size][/font][/center][font=Georgia]
                                                                               [img]https://i.postimg.cc/W44SsHjc/Bundles.png[/img]﻿


[b][size=4]Increased and/or improved rewards for all bundles.
Changed some rules on how to complete a bundle. Anyway the rewards obtained greatly exceed the requirements of each bundle.[/size][/b]

                                                                               [img]https://i.postimg.cc/sD9J7rgR/Monsters.png[/img]


[/font][left][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]﻿Increased weapon damage, increased damage gap (example: 15 minimum damage - 60 maximum damage) more chance ofrandom damage.[/b][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Modified the immunity of the boots (Immunity gives you the probability of not receiving a negative effect from enemies, the higher the value of immunity, the better the probability). Boots defense increased.[/b][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Modify the damage and health of enemies as you wish. [/b][/size][/font]
[/list][/left][font=Georgia]

                                                                               [img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1TXH4H3/Animals.png[/img]

﻿[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]The days necessary for an animal to become an adult and begin to produce were decreased. [/b][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]The days that must pass for an animal to produce were decreased.[/b][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]The sale price of the animals with 5 hearts was modified, increased according to the animal.[/b][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]

                                                                               [img]https://i.postimg.cc/9MksSySK/furnace-1.png[/img]

﻿
[size=4][b]Decreased the amount of ore and/or time you need to make a bar
[font=Georgia][size=4]([b][color=#00ff00]The final values vary depending on the chosen difficulty. See instructions in the folder mod[/color][/b])[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][color=#ff00ff][size=4][b][u][i]Several difficulties, detailed in the mod folder, see the manual there.[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color][/font][/b][/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=3]

                                                            [img]https://i.postimg.cc/xCwPyjm9/leveling.png[/img]


[/size][/font][center][font=Georgia][size=4][b]﻿The amount of experience you gain in all activities will now be increased in a %100, accelerating the process of leveling up. 
If you don't like this you can change it in the settings by following the instructions in the same folder.[/b][/size][/font][/center][font=Georgia]

                                                                               [img]https://i.postimg.cc/SRcfZ0LC/fishing.png[/img]


[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Modified the difficulty of fishing during the fishing mini-game. It varies according to the fish.[/b][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b]Most of the fish were decreased in difficulty.[/b][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][/font][list]
[*][b][font=Georgia][size=4]Modifies the speed and the way the fish move during the mini-game[/size][/font][/b]
[/list][font=Georgia]

                                                                               [img]https://i.postimg.cc/Dwt02m3S/Celeste.png[/img]


[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=5][b][u][i]All these new items are there to help in this new experience making it easier or simpler to progress in the game.[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Added new items such as caps, tiaras, 4 new crops and 1 fruit tree.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Get the new caps and tiaras with the hat mouse.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Added new Objects: Clover Gamma, EnergyBerry, Golden Strawberry, Silver Strawberry, Strawbit, Strawpeach and Winged Golden Strawberry.[/size][/color][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]
[/size][/color][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Added new recipes: Whipped cream, strawberry milk, strawberry cream cup, Lucky milk, Ultra milk. Get it from Gus.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Learn more about these objects as you progress through the game. You will receive mails in your mailbox with information about all these new crops and items. [/i][/b][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]
[/i][/b][/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]All crops have an animated version. [/size][/font]
[/list][/list][font=Georgia][size=4][center][color=#00ffff][/color][/center]

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i][u]-Installation:[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]
[size=4]Extract the mod in the mods folder.
[b]And that's it, great right?[/b]
[/size]
[b][size=5][i][color=#00ffff][u]-Compatibility:[/u][/color][/i]
[/size][/b][size=4]This mod is compatible with windows, linux and mobile versions.
You can use similar mods whenever you change my mod settings to avoid errors or incompatibilities.
It does not negatively affect saved games, but I recommend a new game to enjoy from the beginning.[/size]

[b][color=#ff0000][size=6][i]Important data:[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Due to game limitations, items in possession and bundles will not change during gameplay even if you change the mod options, however, new items will have the expected changes.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]The mod, by modifying so many things, may have incompatibilities with certain mods that modify the same files, discretion is recommended.[/size][/font]
[/list][/size][/font]
